title: Death Spectator
description: A datapack that attempts to simulate a player being kicked after dying.
body:
Attempts to simulate a player being kicked after dying.

How to use: When loading a world, you should see "Death Spectator Loaded". This means the datapack has been loaded without issues.

How it works: When a player dies by any means, they are put into spectator, a fake leave message is sent in chat and a global sound effect is played (Default: wither spawn).

Player Exceptions: To prevent certain players from getting targeted, add the tag "op" to them, which makes them immune from being forced into spectator.

Use cases: Great for Scripted Hardcore videos or roleplays.
